def roman_line(line):
    line=re.sub(r'\\((?:a|s)\\.a?\\.?s?\\.\\)', '', line, flags=re.I) if False else re.sub(r'\\((?:a\\.s\\.|s\\.a\\.)\\)', '', line, flags=re.I)
    if line.isupper():
        line=line.capitalize()
    line=re.sub(r'\\b(abbas|abbasa|ali|sakina|mazhar|farhan|zahra|taha|abal fazl)\\b',lambda m:m.group().title(),line,flags=re.I)
    return re.sub(r'\\s+(["'!?.])$'"',r'\\1',line).rstrip('.')
digits=str.maketrans('0123456789','۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')
roman_blocks=[]
source_blocks=[]
i=0

    roman_blocks.append('\\n'.join(([str(n)] if n else [])+[roman_line(l) for l in roman[i:i+count]]))

    i+=count
